title: Seede tiiɗɗo
intro: Haala luggiɗka ina feeña, ina hollita pellital renndo ngo aldaa e paltoor e nder njiyaagu mawngu. Daartol maɓɓe ina waɗi seedantaagal goonɗinal, hay so tawii ko e dow sadak timmuɗo. Ndee ɗoo tinndinoore ina siftina en doole goongɗinal e tooñanngeeji ɓurɗi heewde.
clues: Min ngonnoo ko fedde nde daartol mum ina haalee e suura juutɗo, baawɗo, jeertinoowo e tooñanngeeji.
En kawrii e laamɗo jiɗɗo ittude gooŋɗinal men e Alla gooto, joom jappeere, yettoode.
En mbaɗii jarribo kulɓiniingo, ngo ɓuuɓol mawngol ɓuuɓnaa e leydi.
En njiyii no gooŋɗinɓe, haa arti noon e sukaaɓe tokosɓe, mberletee e nder jeyngol ɓuuɓngol e nder oon ɓuuɓri.
Torlotooɓe men ɓee kuɗaama sabu golle mum en, min fodanaama njoɓdi mawndi sabu darnde amen.
Eɓɓoore laamɗo oo ngam momtude iimanaagal men tan, tiiɗtinii nokku men e martabaaji e yeeso Alla, seedtotooɗo geɗe kala.
arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
